name: regress
description: Regress — catch what changed before your users do. Test case management with version history, flakiness scoring, scheduler, and real Cypress execution.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres && npm run db:wait
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U tcm -d tcm
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.test:unit: node --test utils/cron.test.js utils/flakiness.test.js utils/diff.test.js utils/executor.test.js middleware/registrationGate.test.js
